prompt: Production sprite sheet for an atmospheric, slightly abandoned 2D pixel-art neighborhood RPG. Exactly FOUR separated architectural entrance sprites in a regular 2 by 2 grid, 384x384 per cell, total 768x768. Pure solid magenta background, no checkerboard, no captions, no letters, no humans, no furniture, no extra panels. Top-left: FRONT OPEN. Top-right: same FRONT CLOSED. Bottom-left: SIDE OPEN. Bottom-right: same SIDE CLOSED. Same dimensions for each open/closed pair. Restrained weathered olive, warm plaster, muted grey masonry, small tarnished brass accents. Hand-placed readable pixel clusters, granular worn surfaces, subtle old cracks and edge highlights, no painterly smooth gradients or heavy black cartoon outlines. In each cell keep at least 35px clear magenta margin. Camera is high orthographic RPG cutaway view, about 55 degrees down from horizontal, axes aligned to screen, no vanishing point and NO isometric diamond geometry. FRONT entrance belongs to a horizontal wall: broad top surfaces, compressed vertical facade, threshold along bottom. SIDE entrance belongs to a vertical wall on the LEFT of a street: travel is horizontal left-right. Show the wall cutaway/top surfaces of the north and south piers, deep horizontal threshold connecting to street on RIGHT, building interior on LEFT. It must visually belong IN THE WALL, not a freestanding portal, not a fence on paving. Do NOT turn the front facade 90 degrees. Side vertical facade is edge-on; never draw a frontal door panel facing the camera in the side entrance. Keep opening at the center of the wall segment. A: RECESSED MASONRY DOOR. Modest deep doorway integrated into a short section of thick cracked warm-olive plaster wall with weathered exposed brick returns. Short squared stone sill, shallow dark interior, a simple old green timber leaf folding against the inside left jamb in OPEN. No ornate columns, no gold moldings, no monumental cap. Front wall surrounds the leaf and shows convincing thickness. SIDE view: thick north/south plaster piers with exposed brick ends, recessed shadowed passage and single short broad stone threshold. CLOSED side has only the narrow edge of the timber leaf spanning north-south across the recess. Keep plaster wall at both ends, source floor paving minimal and small-grained. Roof excluded so existing game roof can overlap left edge.
